CONNECT

COME AS YOU ARE

We are all imperfect people pursued by a perfect God. If you can relate to not being perfect then this is home. You belong here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU EXPECT?

If you have never been to church before (or it’s been a while), it can be nothing short of scary to show up without knowing what to expect. To preview what one of our services look like, watch here.

​

No matter what you've been through or what questions you might have about God and faith, our church is a place where you'll find the love, grace, and forgiveness Jesus gives to everyone.

​

What we can promise you is that you’ll meet really good people, experience music that sounds great but also has something to it that’s hard to explain, and you’ll hear a message from the Bible that you can apply to your life right away.

Frequently asked questions

We start right at 10:30am in-person and online!

At FCC, you’ll see everything from suits to T-shirts and shorts. Wear what makes you feel comfortable—you’re among family here!

Pre-registration is NO LONGER REQUIRED to attend our services in person! Also, masks are optional and are available for those wanting to wear one!

You aren’t alone in asking that. The answer is no, not really. You will hear that we talk about money because, let’s be real, it’s an important aspect of our lives. For those who call FCC their home we do ask for them to financially partner with us. But we don’t pass a collection plate around or anything like that or beg you to give.

Our entire service is between 60-90 minutes. When you enter you will be welcomed by a greeter. You can go grab a seat in the main auditorium or let an usher help you find a seat. Our FCC band will begin playing music at 10:30am, you are welcome to sing along as the words are shown on the screens or just take it all in. Following the music there will be a relevant teaching from the Bible that will inspire you and be applicable to your life from one of our pastors.

Yes! FCC Kids is a place where your kids can have fun, grow, and discover just how much God loves them. Learn more.

We are a Christian church, but you do not have to be a Christian to attend. Each week we meet people who are just exploring life and the questions it brings.

That is okay! We know everyone has a different level of comfort, so please do what you feel is best for you and your family—whether that’s watching at home or joining us in person. If you are looking for some fellowship while watching church but aren’t comfortable coming to a service just yet, we encourage you to join us online!
